**📅 August 20, 2026**
**📊 Market Sentiment:** Neutral
**🎯 Confidence:** High

**🧠 Key Themes**
• Treasury buybacks suppressing yields amid $40T debt overhang and fiscal stress
• Fed minutes reveal growing support for rate hikes if inflation doesn't cool
• Bond market volatility transmitting to tech/semiconductor sector weakness
• Middle East tensions keeping oil elevated and supply chains at risk

**⚠️ Notable Risks**
• September corporate issuance wall could shatter Treasury market calm
• Strait of Hormuz escalation threatening energy supply and inflation
• Fed rate hike threat amid sticky inflation and record debt

**📈 Volatility Outlook:** Rising

**🧾 One-Line Take**
Treasury buybacks are masking severe fiscal and monetary stress, leaving volatility asymmetrically skewed to the upside.
